# rzone.de
> RZone is a German RC helicopter and model aviation community site with forums, classifieds, clubs, and event information.

The site centers on community discussion around RC helicopters and related model flying topics, with structured areas for marketplace listings, club directories, event calendars, and member services.

## Community
- [Forum](https://rzone.de/forum): Main discussion forum for RC helicopters, electronics, mechanics, and flying topics.
- [Portal](https://rzone.de/portal): Community landing page with recent activity and highlighted site content.
- [Members](https://rzone.de/memberlist): Directory of registered community members and user profiles.
- [Search](https://rzone.de/search): Search interface for finding forum posts, topics, and member content.
- [Help](https://rzone.de/help): Forum help pages covering usage, features, and community functions.

## Forum Areas
- [Helicopter Forum](https://rzone.de/forum/forumdisplay.php?f=1): Discussion area for RC helicopter models, setup, and flight experiences.
- [Electronics Forum](https://rzone.de/forum/forumdisplay.php?f=2): Topics covering servos, gyros, ESCs, receivers, and onboard electronics.
- [Mechanics Forum](https://rzone.de/forum/forumdisplay.php?f=3): Mechanical setup, maintenance, drivetrain, and airframe discussion.
- [Beginner Forum](https://rzone.de/forum/forumdisplay.php?f=4): Introductory help for newcomers to RC helicopters and model flying.
- [Scale Helicopters](https://rzone.de/forum/forumdisplay.php?f=5): Community discussions focused on scale helicopter builds and flying.
- [Off Topic](https://rzone.de/forum/forumdisplay.php?f=6): General community conversation outside core technical flying topics.

## Marketplace
- [Classifieds](https://rzone.de/classifieds): Main marketplace for buying and selling RC helicopters and accessories.
- [Helicopters for Sale](https://rzone.de/classifieds/helicopter): Listings for complete RC helicopter models and airframes.
- [Electronics for Sale](https://rzone.de/classifieds/elektronik): Marketplace category for radio and onboard electronic components.
- [Accessories](https://rzone.de/classifieds/zubehoer): Listings for tools, parts, upgrades, and supporting equipment.
- [Wanted Ads](https://rzone.de/classifieds/gesuche): Requests from members seeking specific models, parts, or equipment.
- [Create Listing](https://rzone.de/classifieds/create): Form for posting a new classified advertisement.

## Clubs and Flying Sites
- [Clubs](https://rzone.de/vereine): Directory of model flying clubs and associations.
- [Club Map](https://rzone.de/vereine/karte): Map view of clubs and flying locations.
- [Add Club](https://rzone.de/vereine/eintragen): Submission page for adding a new club entry.
- [Flying Sites](https://rzone.de/flugplaetze): Directory of flying fields and model aviation locations.
- [Flying Site Map](https://rzone.de/flugplaetze/karte): Geographic overview of listed flying sites and fields.

## Events
- [Events](https://rzone.de/termine): Calendar of RC helicopter and model aviation events.
- [Event Calendar](https://rzone.de/termine/kalender): Calendar view for upcoming meetings, fly-ins, and competitions.
- [Add Event](https://rzone.de/termine/eintragen): Submission form for community event announcements.
- [Event Map](https://rzone.de/termine/karte): Map-based overview of scheduled events and locations.

## Media and Downloads
- [Gallery](https://rzone.de/galerie): Community photo gallery featuring models, builds, and event images.
- [Videos](https://rzone.de/videos): Video area for flight footage, demonstrations, and community media.
- [Downloads](https://rzone.de/downloads): Download section for files, manuals, and shared resources.
- [Articles](https://rzone.de/artikel): Editorial and community-written articles related to RC helicopters.

## Member Services
- [Register](https://rzone.de/register): Account registration page for joining the RZone community.
- [Login](https://rzone.de/login): Sign-in page for member access to forums and site features.
- [Private Messages](https://rzone.de/private.php): Member messaging area for direct communication.
- [User Control Panel](https://rzone.de/usercp): Personal settings and account management for registered users.
- [Subscriptions](https://rzone.de/subscription.php): Manage watched threads, forums, and notification preferences.

## Site Information
- [FAQ](https://rzone.de/faq): Frequently asked questions about site usage and community features.
- [Rules](https://rzone.de/regeln): Community rules and participation guidelines.
- [Contact](https://rzone.de/kontakt): Contact page for reaching site operators or administrators.
- [Imprint](https://rzone.de/impressum): Legal notice and publisher information for the website.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rzone.de/datenschutz): Privacy information and data handling details.
- [Terms](https://rzone.de/nutzungsbedingungen): Terms of use governing access to the platform.
